opening.argument: OneCoin is promoted as a “once in a lifetime opportunity,” alongside instructions to buy and sell stock or shares and trade a token on the main exchange. Those calls to participate and move money are linked to investing in a place with “a lot of profit.” Together, the opportunity pitch, trading instructions, and profit claim establish a scam investment solicitation. No completed transaction or realized return is shown; the case rests on the promotion and solicitation themselves.
